Any caller with that scope can approve, even if they are not an approver."},{"path":"src/server/approvals.ts","line":26,"kind":"risk","claim":"`withTx` directly invokes the callback and does not create a transaction, despite the caller relying on it to make the approval insert and invoice update atomic. A failure during the update can leave an approval record without the corresponding invoice status change."},{"path":"src/server/approvals.ts","line":13,"kind":"risk","claim":"Approval inserts a record and sets the invoice status to `approved` without checking the invoice's current status. This allows the approval route to overwrite other states, including `paid`."},{"path":"src/server/payments.ts","line":24,"kind":"risk","claim":"`markInvoicePaid` requires only that the invoice is approved, then sets it to paid without receiving or verifying bank confirmation. The route exposes this operation to callers with `billing:admin`, so an authorized admin can mark an invoice paid without evidence of payment."}],"inspected":["src/server/routes.ts","src/server/auth.ts","src/server/approvals.ts","src/server/payments.ts"]}
